results.question: Cât am cheltuit pe cumpărături de la supermarket în martie 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Groceries' AND month = 3 AND year = 2026

results.question: Cât am cheltuit pe mâncare în martie 2026 față de februarie 2026?
results.sql: SELECT month_start, round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS food_ron FROM expenses WHERE category IN ('Groceries', 'Restaurants', 'Food Delivery') AND month_start IN (DATE '2026-02-01', DATE '2026-03-01') GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY month_start

results.question: How much did I spend on fuel in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS fuel_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Fuel' AND year = 2025

results.question: Care a fost salariul meu total în 2025?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS total_salary_ron FROM income WHERE category = 'Salary' AND year = 2025

results.question: How much did I spend at Kaufland in total?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS total_spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE merchant ILIKE '%KAUFLAND%'

results.question: Cât am plătit pe abonamente în 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Subscriptions' AND year = 2026

results.question: What were my top 3 spending categories in August 2025?
results.sql: SELECT category, round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE month = 8 AND year = 2025 GROUP BY category ORDER BY spent_ron DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: În ce lună am cheltuit cel mai mult la restaurante?
results.sql: SELECT month_start AS month, round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Restaurants' GROUP BY month_start ORDER BY spent_ron DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How much did I spend in euros in August 2025?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) AS euros_spent FROM expenses WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND month = 8 AND year = 2025

results.question: Cât am plătit chirie în total?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS total_rent_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Rent'

results.question: How much did Netflix cost me in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS netflix_cost_ron FROM expenses WHERE merchant ILIKE '%NETFLIX%' AND year = 2026

results.question: Care este soldul fiecărui cont?
results.sql: SELECT bank, account, round(balance, 2) AS balance_ron FROM balances

results.question: How many Bolt or Uber rides did I take in July 2026?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rides_count FROM expenses WHERE (merchant ILIKE '%BOLT%' OR merchant ILIKE '%UBER%') AND month = 7 AND year = 2026

results.question: Cât am cheltuit pe utilități în iarnă, din decembrie 2025 până în februarie 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS utilities_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Utilities' AND month_start BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'

results.question: What is my average monthly spending on groceries?
results.sql: SELECT round(avg(total), 2) AS avg_monthly_spending FROM (SELECT month_start, sum(amount_ron) AS total FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Groceries' GROUP BY month_start)

results.question: Câți bani am retras cash în 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS cash_withdrawals_ron FROM transactions WHERE kind = 'expense' AND category = 'Cash' AND year = 2026

results.question: How much interest have I earned in total?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS total_interest_ron FROM income WHERE category = 'Other Income' AND description ILIKE '%DOBANDA%'

results.question: Cât am plătit comisioane bancare în 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS fees_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Fees' AND year = 2026

results.question: Cât am cheltuit pe sănătate anul acesta?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS health_spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Health' AND year = 2026

results.question: Which merchant did I spend the most money at in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT merchant, round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE year = 2025 GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY spent_ron DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How much did I spend in total in September 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS total_spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE month = 9 AND year = 2026

results.question: Am cheltuit mai mult în iulie sau în august 2026?
results.sql: SELECT month_start, category, round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS spent_ron FROM expenses WHERE year = 2026 AND (month = 7 OR month = 8) GROUP BY month_start, category ORDER BY month_start, spent_ron DESC

results.question: What was my total income in 2026?
results.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS total_income_ron FROM income WHERE year = 2026

results.question: Cât am economisit în 2025, adică venituri minus cheltuieli?
results.sql: SELECT round((SELECT sum(amount_ron) FROM income WHERE year = 2025) - (SELECT sum(amount_ron) FROM expenses WHERE year = 2025), 2) AS savings_ron

results.question: Ce abonamente am plătit în 2026 și cât m-a costat fiecare?
results.sql: SELECT category, merchant, round(sum(amount_ron), 2) AS cost_ron FROM expenses WHERE category = 'Subscriptions' AND year = 2026 GROUP BY category, merchant ORDER BY cost_ron DESC
